intended_use: Internal non-commercial research comparison only; not for clinical diagnosis, deployment, or autonomous patient decisions.

model.backbone: RETFound-Green ViT-S/14 reg4 with DINOv2 architecture
model.input_preprocessing: RGB; resize to 392x392; convert to float [0,1]; normalize each channel with mean 0.5 and standard deviation 0.5.
model.training_augmentation: Random horizontal flip, random rotation up to 5 degrees, brightness jitter 0.08, contrast jitter 0.08, saturation jitter 0.04.
model.quality_head: Not included in this frozen comparator; quality auxiliary weight 0.0.

training.losses: Masked five-grade DR cross entropy, referable DR binary cross entropy, masked glaucoma binary cross entropy, and source classification cross entropy with gradient reversal on the encoder.
training.sampling: WeightedRandomSampler balancing source and labeled disease groups; replacement sampling.
training.selection_rule: Highest internal validation referable-DR AUROC among the fixed 16-epoch run; no test split was read.
training.train_only_DDR: DDR labeled and gradability rows were used for disease supervision only; DDR excluded from source-adversarial classes and validation due unverified patient IDs / no validation rows.

data_and_provenance.weights_and_row_level_predictions: Weights and row-level predictions were recovered to local private recovery folders; they remain excluded from repository artifacts.

internal_validation_patient_metrics.aggregation: Source-patient group; positive if any labeled image is positive; score is maximum image score.

glaucoma_HYGD.note: Small internal validation; do not generalize or describe as clinical performance.

seed_sensitivity.interpretation: The high seed-1 fixed-threshold specificity did not reproduce; model scores/operating point are seed-sensitive. The source-invariance ablation did not show a statistically distinguishable AUROC/AUPRC gain over the matched control.

claim_boundary: Exposed internal development validation only. Not independent external validation, clinical validation, diagnosis certification, or evidence of safe autonomous use.
license_boundary: Non-commercial internal research only under the applicable RETFound-Green terms; no commercial/clinical deployment, sublicensing, or weight redistribution authorization is asserted.
